subject.title: refactor: make Telegram release workflow tests behavioral

question: After conflict resolution, should this maintainer-owned refactor land with the helper-based status path, provided the trusted checkout remains pinned to the identity-bound repository and full SHA?
rationale: The current branch cannot merge as reviewed, and conflict resolution changes the exact release-automation code that will execute.

options.title: Rebase and preserve the boundary
options.body: Resolve conflicts, retain the post-identity pinned trusted helper checkout and behavioral coverage, then revalidate the exact rebased head.

options.title: Pause the refactor
options.body: Keep the existing inline implementation if the rebase cannot preserve the identity-before-code-execution invariant without broader release-workflow changes.

recommendation.title: Rebase and preserve the boundary
recommendation.body: Resolve conflicts, retain the post-identity pinned trusted helper checkout and behavioral coverage, then revalidate the exact rebased head.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the current release-workflow and test refactor and are best placed to resolve its merge conflict before another maintainer validates the exact head.
